name: Rewarble Nimy Max Mastercard
summary: A reloadable virtual Mastercard designed for digital payments with support for Apple Pay and Google Pay.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Rewarble Nimy Max Mastercard charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$2.5 per month. Card issuance is US$1.99.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Rewarble Nimy Max Mastercard?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.
